newsitem.title: USA: U.S. northwest gas pipe explodes, no injuries.
newsitem.headline: U.S. northwest gas pipe explodes, no injuries.

text.p: A gas pipeline operated by Northwest Pipeline of Salt Lake City, Utah exploded on Sunday in Washington state, just south of the border with Canada's British Columbia province, police said.
The 26-inch (66 cm) feeder pipe bringing gas into the United States ruptured and shot flames into the night sky near Everson, some 90 miles (145 km) north of Seattle, about 1:15 A.M. EST.

Everson police said there were no reported injuries and no homes had been evacuated. Emergency crews were still in the process of shutting down the line and bringing the fire under control at 3 A.M. EST.
Police said flames could be seen as far away as Bellingham, some 15 miles (25 km) to the southwest.
